supply.note: M11.3 (plan slice 45): game-design values, no source. Separation from the Verwundetennest and caches as legitimate targets are owner answers (2026-11-16); the 50 m apart and the 15 m clear zone are software choices. Cook-off: a light vehicle's ammunition rack as model (M7.4a); a burst sets a crate off with a chance per kg of filling (a 120 mm round on it about 0.6, a 152/155 mm round 0.9 and destroyed outright), within 5 m x filling^(1/3); a fire burns 30-120 s (plan), rifle rounds burn and pop without fragments (general knowledge, low). Taking at a crate: 0.4 s a round into a magazine (stripper clips and a loader, as refillMagazines with clips), 0.02 s a round of loose clips into a bandolier. Capture after 10 s with an enemy within 10 m and none of its side within 50 m (plan).
